entries.title: Yie Ar Kung-Fu

emulation.notes: MAME is only a comparison route if official Arcade Archives or original hardware is unavailable.

primary.why: Yie Ar Kung-Fu is an arcade fighting game, and the Arcade Archives release is the current official preservation route with practical capture options and arcade-setting documentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Arcade Archives release on Switch or PS4/PS5 backward compatibility. Record platform, region, display/filter settings, difficulty/lives, controller, score route, and whether original arcade hardware or home ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if exact arcade hardware preservation is required.
secondary.why: Arcade Archives is easier to capture, but original hardware is the historical reference.

secondary.platform: NES / MSX / Commodore 64 and other home ports
secondary.why: The arcade game is the primary version identity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Log Arcade Archives display/filter/difficulty settings and do not merge home-port behavior with arcade scoring.
